## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable, hardworking, and managing woman who never shirks her duties. Known as a kindly soul with a kind heart, she is nevertheless an officious, outspoken, and blunt person who prides herself on always speaking her mind. She acts as an overseeing presence in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), actively nagging people to do right and offering a critical, pessimistic, yet farseeing perspective as a shrewd judge of human nature. Highly pious, she strongly opposes play-acting, horse racing, and the higher education of women, believing the latter unfits them for their true sphere. Additionally, she loves to be asked for advice, enjoys sewing, and excels at making prize-winning homemade butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde raised ten children and buried two, and she was well known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for having knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts. After spotting [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving off in his best clothes, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and learned that he and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) were adopting an orphan boy, expressing strong disapproval over taking in a stranger child. When she later visited and insulted the looks of the orphan girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), the child flew into a rage, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually delivered a dramatic apology that completely appeased Mrs. Lynde. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later consulted Mrs. Lynde for advice when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to return to school after a public humiliation, and Mrs. Lynde recommended letting the girl stay home until she calmed down.

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share a longstanding friendship despite their personal differences. Mrs. Rachel frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), offering her opinions on household matters and serving as an advisor to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's upbringing. Though Mrs. Rachel can be critical—such as when she initially disapproved of adopting an orphan or when she insulted Anne's appearance—she and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintain a close, collaborative relationship, often attending events like political rallies together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), +17 more_

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is the husband of Rachel Lynde. The two live together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) while Rachel manages community gossip, visits neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and attends outside political functions.
